tasks.analysis: Conservation ecology focuses on preserving biodiversity and protecting ecosystems from degradation. This discipline involves studying the interactions between species and their environments to develop strategies for maintaining ecological balance. Efforts include habitat restoration, sustainable resource management, and the establishment of protected areas. Conservation ecologists work to mitigate the impacts of human activities such as deforestation, pollution, and climate change. Public awareness campaigns and policy advocacy are crucial components of conservation initiatives. By safeguarding natural habitats, conservation ecology aims to ensure the survival of diverse species and the health of the planet. 保护生态学致力于保护生物多样性、防止生态系统退化。该学科研究物种与环境间的相互作用，以制定维持生态平衡的策略。相关工作包括栖息地修复、资源可持续管理及建立保护区。保护生态学家致力于减少森林砍伐、污染、气候变化等人类活动的影响。公众意识宣传与政策倡导是保护行动的重要部分。通过保护自然栖息地，保护生态学旨在确保多样物种的生存与地球健康。
